title: Tic Tac Toe
description: Play the classic X and O game.
about:
Tic Tac Toe is a browser game where you place X or O in an empty square and try to make a line of three. Start a new match with the on-screen button.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Place X or O in an empty square and try to make a line of three. Start a new match with the on-screen button.
tips: Use click / tap to place your mark.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Tic Tac Toe?
faq.answer: Place X or O in an empty square and try to make a line of three. Start a new match with the on-screen button.

faq.question: Can I play Tic Tac Toe in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
